verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm whose offering is attorney-led legal services (petitions, visas, compliance). User-driven bulk operations across many items is a software-automation axis that does not fit this kind of product. Its client portal is documented only for uploading and reviewing documents, messaging, and status tracking, with no batch or bulk capability, and no API was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
